title.zh: 延长农业竞争力提升基金的使用期限，修订第8178号共和国法（以关税取代除稻米外农产品的数量进口限制、设立农业竞争力提升基金）
title.en: An Act to Extend the Utilization Period of the Agricultural Competitiveness Enhancement Fund, Amending Republic Act No. 8178, Entitled "An Act Replacing Quantitative Import Restrictions on Agricultural Products, Except Rice, with Tariffs, Creating the Agricultural Competitiveness Enhancement Fund, and for Other Purposes"
title.orig: An Act to Extend the Utilization Period of the Agricultural Competitiveness Enhancement Fund, Amending Republic Act No. 8178, Entitled "An Act Replacing Quantitative Import Restrictions on Agricultural Products, Except Rice, with Tariffs, Creating the Agricultural Competitiveness Enhancement Fund, and for Other Purposes"

completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2008/ra_9496_2008.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
The Department of Agriculture, in consultation with the Congressional Oversight Committee on Agricultural and Fisheries Modernization (COCAFM), shall forthwith revise and reform its implementing guidelines including the approval procedures in order to speed up the processing and disbursement process and, in coordination with the Philippine Information Agency, shall ensure the widest information dissemination possible of this Act.
The Department of Agriculture with the concurrence of the Congressional Oversight Committee on Agricultural and Fisheries Modernization shall draw up a prioritization plan for the optimum utilization of the Fund.
Repealing Clause. - Republic Act No. 8178 is hereby amended. All laws, decrees, executive issuances, rules and regulations inconsistent with this Act are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

Separability Clause. - The Provisions of this Act are hereby declared to be separable and, in the event one (1) or more of such provisions are held unconstitutional, the validity of the other provisions shall bot be affected thereby.
Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect immediately upon its approval.
